stages.text: Walk a lap of the Approach Concourse - WASD or the arrow keys.

one_way_message.text: You're on the induction - it tracks in your Mission Log (3). Feet first: walk the length of an approach arm on WASD or the arrow keys.

stages.text: Target someone - press Q or E to cycle a lock, or click them.

one_way_message.text: See everyone on the ring? Tap Q or E to cycle a target lock, or just click a person. Their name and role show top-right.

stages.text: Walk up to someone and talk - press T.

one_way_message.text: Get in close to anyone and press T. Shopkeepers open their store; everyone else has something to say.

stages.text: Open your Mission Log - press 4.

one_way_message.text: Press 4 for your Mission Log. Every step I give you is listed there.

stages.text: Open your Possessions - press 2 (check the Standing panel).

one_way_message.text: Press 2 for Possessions - credits, ships, cargo, and your Standing with each faction.

stages.text: Take the Authority starter loan - Signal Officer Doss, Lender's Office (south arm).

one_way_message.text: The south arm - the Lender's Office. Talk to Signal Officer Doss and take the starter loan - you'll need it for a hull.

stages.text: Buy a ship - Harbor-Master Crane, the Berth (east arm).

one_way_message.text: The Berth is the east arm - the one you docked in. Harbor-Master Crane has hulls for sale there; the courier's an easy first ship. Buy whichever you like.

stages.text: Board your ship - step on the Berth portal and press G.

one_way_message.text: That's the ring done. Your ship's docked at the Berth - step on the portal and press G to board. I'll raise you once you're in the cockpit.

stages.text: Turn both ways - left (A / Left), then right (D / Right).

one_way_message.text: Hub Control, reading you in the cockpit. Start simple - turn left with A, then right with D. Give me both.

stages.text: Thrust forward - W or Up. Watch your speed build.

one_way_message.text: Good. Hold W to thrust. Space doesn't slow you down on its own - remember that.

stages.text: Turn around and brake until your speed drops - S, then thrust.

one_way_message.text: Now cancel it - hold S to point retrograde, then thrust to kill your speed.

stages.text: Fly clear of the system centre, then jump to Kiln (1 to pick it, V to jump).

one_way_message.text: Last thing. Kiln's beacon is keyed - fly well clear of the star until the drift prompt shows, open the Star Map (1), select Kiln, and press V. Log what you find there, pilot. Halcyon out.

stages.text: Have your mark witnessed - Warden of Contract Raik, the Contract Hall (north-west of the Hold).

one_way_message.text: The Warden of Contract witnesses first. The Contract Hall stands on the north-west of the Hold floor. Put your hand on the seal-stone.

stages.text: Collect the sealed manifest from Tallykeeper Vess, the Assay Office (north side of the Hold).

one_way_message.text: Vess has the manifest in the Assay Office, north side of the Hold. Sealed. You carry it - you do not open it.

stages.text: Fly to the moon Shaft VII and land at its headworks.

one_way_message.text: Shaft VII is the near moon. Fly clear of the Hold, match the moon, and set down at the headworks pad.

stages.text: Deliver the manifest to Deepmaster Orin and take his tally.

one_way_message.text: Deepmaster Orin runs the headworks. Hand him the manifest - sealed - and bring back his tally.

stages.text: Carry the tally back to Tallykeeper Vess at the Combine Hold.

one_way_message.text: Back to Vess with Orin's tally. Then the carriage is closed and the Factor will key Verdance's lane.

stages.text: Report to Factor Tol.

one_way_message.text: Come and tell me it's done. The Combine keys Verdance's beacon for a partner who kept terms - and remembers you now know our door.

stages.text: Hear Ferry-wright Osei's view - the Ferry Slip (north-east).

one_way_message.text: Osei's at the Ferry Slip, on the north-east rim of the Walk. He'll have an opinion - he always does.

stages.text: Hear Water-keeper Tam's view - the Water Office (south-west).

one_way_message.text: Tam keeps the water accounts, south-west. Hers is the cautious voice. Hear it properly.

stages.text: Hear Old Bevin's view - Canopy Rest (south-east).

one_way_message.text: Bevin's down in Canopy Rest with a cup. Sixty years of watching us dither - he's earned a hearing.

stages.text: Bring the three views back to Sela and let the assembly sit.

one_way_message.text: You've heard all three? Come back to the assembly floor. With every view in the room in person, we have to choose - and we will.

stages.text: Read the First Wall with Warden of Names Vane - the Long Vault, first niche up the east wall of the nave.

one_way_message.text: Warden of Names Vane keeps the First Wall in the Long Vault. The first year's names, and the order that started the Silence. Read it.

stages.text: Read the middle years with Brother Sol - the Reading Cells, further up the east wall of the nave.

one_way_message.text: Brother Sol has the middle-year accounts in the Reading Cells. Three explanations, none certain. Read all three - the uncertainty is the honest part.

stages.text: Enter the Vault of the First Decade with Sister Edda, at the crowned head of the nave.

one_way_message.text: Sister Edda holds the inner Vault. What the First Decade sent toward the core, and why the last choice was left to whoever reached it. To you.

stages.text: Return to Keeper Aramis.

one_way_message.text: Come back to me. I will light the lane to the Span, and you will carry the wall's account into whatever is waiting there.

stages.text: Carry the relief load to Ossuary - jump there.

one_way_message.text: Load's aboard - grain, water filters, med stock. Ossuary's the Vigil; they won't ask and they won't thank you, but they need it. Jump when you're clear.

stages.text: Land at the Name-Wall and hand the load over.

one_way_message.text: Set down at the Name-Wall dock. Sister Edda's people will take it from the hold. That's the run.

stages.text: Take word back down the lane - jump to Verdance.

one_way_message.text: Good. Now back to Verdance - the Drift's still arguing and they should hear it landed. We owe you one, and we pay those.

stages.text: Jump to Kiln before the Combine seals the lane.

one_way_message.text: There's a carrier crew still on the ground at Combine Hold - their hull's impounded and the lane's closing around them. Get in there before the patrols lock it down.

stages.text: Dock at Combine Hold and get the stranded crew aboard.

one_way_message.text: Four of them, light kit, they'll fit. The Combine won't stop a hull that's leaving - it's hulls that stay they have a problem with.

stages.text: Get them clear - jump back to Verdance.

one_way_message.text: Out. Don't wait for an escort, don't answer a hail, just go. Verdance when you're through.

stages.text: Meet the barge Highcanopy-Nine over Verdance and signal ready - hail Barge-mother Sethe.

one_way_message.text: Barge Highcanopy-Nine is loading now - forty families, everything they could carry. Sethe flies the moment you're alongside and hail her. Stay between her and the Combine.

stages.text: Hold escort to Ossuary - jump when the barge is with you.

one_way_message.text: We're slow and we're full. Match our speed, keep the blockade off our flank, and jump to Ossuary when we're clear of the Highcanopy shelf. We'll be right behind you.

stages.text: See the barge down at the Name-Wall - land at the Vigil dock.

one_way_message.text: Ossuary. The Vigil keeps a quiet dock and asks nothing - set down at the Name-Wall and they'll take my people in. Land alongside us.

stages.text: Report back to the Drift - jump to Verdance.

one_way_message.text: They're down and safe - word already reached us. Come back to Highcanopy. The assembly should hear it from the pilot who flew it.

stages.text: Read the front's approach at the Kiln relay - jump to Kiln.

one_way_message.text: The relight signal handshakes every beacon it passes and the Kiln relay logged the lot. Jump to Kiln - the record is on the ground at Combine Hold.

stages.text: Pull the beacon's own handshake logs - land at Combine Hold, then talk to Assay-clerk Dorn.

one_way_message.text: Combine Hold weighs everything twice, the signal included. Assay-clerk Dorn keeps the relay tally. Ask for the front's timing - the Combine has no use for it and will part with it cheap.

stages.text: Get the record to someone who'll act on it - jump to Verdance.

one_way_message.text: You have the front's timing. It is worth something to whoever wants to be ready for it. Verdance is the crossroads - jump there and decide who gets it.

stages.text: Deliver the intelligence - Records Keeper Amsel (Hub Control), Sela of Highcanopy, or Keeper Aramis (the Name-Wall).

one_way_message.text: Three parties want this. The Authority at Hub Control would run the region on it. The Drift at Highcanopy would open their lanes ahead of it. The Vigil at the Name-Wall would slow it. Choose - you only get to hand it over once.

stages.text: Read the Hub's own account of the shutdown - the Archivist of the Choir, the Hub Archive.

one_way_message.text: The Hub Archive is the machine's own memory of the night it went dark - three logs, and they do not agree. Read them with the Archivist. Linger on the one you believe.

stages.text: Walk the Core Choir and hear what is relighting the beacons - the Core Voice.

one_way_message.text: Now the Choir. The Core Voice will give you three readings of what is out there lighting the lanes. None of them is confirmed. Take the one you can carry.

stages.text: Return to the First Warden.

one_way_message.text: Come back to me when you have both. Then the choice is yours to make, and I will not make it easier than it is.
